originalDsl:
@diagram architecture
@coralVersion "0.2.8"
@profileVersion "1.0.0"
@catalogVersion "1.0.0"
@conformanceLevel typical
layout [direction: DOWN]

User service as "User"
PostService service as "Post Service"
ModerationQueue database as "Moderation Queue"
AIClassifier service as "AI Content Classifier"
HumanReviewer service as "Human Reviewer"
PolicyEngine module as "Policy Engine"
PublishService service as "Publish Service"
NotifyService service as "Notification Service"
AppealService service as "Appeal Service"
edge_1 = User -> PostService [secondEnd: arrow] as "submits post"
edge_2 = PostService -> ModerationQueue [secondEnd: arrow] as "enqueue for review"
edge_3 = ModerationQueue -> AIClassifier [secondEnd: arrow] as "send to classifier"
edge_4 = AIClassifier -> HumanReviewer [secondEnd: arrow] as "flag as uncertain"
edge_5 = AIClassifier -> PolicyEngine [secondEnd: arrow] as "auto-approve"
edge_6 = HumanReviewer -> PolicyEngine [secondEnd: arrow] as "submit decision"
edge_7 = PolicyEngine -> PublishService [secondEnd: arrow] as "approve"
edge_8 = PolicyEngine -> NotifyService [secondEnd: arrow] as "reject"
edge_9 = PublishService -> NotifyService [secondEnd: arrow] as "notify author"
edge_10 = User -> AppealService [secondEnd: arrow] as "files appeal"
edge_11 = AppealService -> ModerationQueue [secondEnd: arrow] as "re-queue for review"

injectedDefects.description: removed opening quote on label "Appeal Service"
